title: Complex Relative Clauses
description: Который in oblique cases and with prepositions
descriptionRussian: Который в косвенных падежах и с предлогами
intro: At A2 you learned который agreeing in gender/number with its antecedent. At B1, master который in ALL cases and with prepositions. The case of который depends on its role in the relative clause: Человек, которого я видел (whom I saw - accusative). Друг, которому я звонил (whom I called - dative). Книга, о которой мы говорили (which we talked about - prepositional). The preposition goes BEFORE который.
rules: Который agrees in GENDER/NUMBER with antecedent, but CASE depends on its role in the clause.
Accusative (direct object): Человек, которого я встретил. (The person whom I met.)
Dative (indirect object): Друг, которому я помог. (The friend whom I helped.)
With prepositions: preposition + который: Дом, в котором я живу. (The house in which I live.)
examples: Студент, которого я знаю, очень умный. (The student whom I know is very smart.), accusative
Девушка, которой я дал книгу, моя сестра. (The girl to whom I gave the book is my sister.), dative
Город, в котором я родился, небольшой. (The city in which I was born is small.), prepositional
Человек, с которым я работаю, из Москвы. (The person with whom I work is from Moscow.), instrumental

items.promptEnglish: Here's the book you were looking for.

items.prompt: Друг, _____ я позвонил, не ответил. (The friend whom I called didn't answer.)
items.promptEnglish: The friend whom I called didn't answer.

items.prompt: Дом, в _____ мы живём, старый. (The house in which we live is old.)
items.promptEnglish: The house in which we live is old.

items.promptEnglish: The person with whom I work is very kind.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Который in oblique cases with prepositions
hints: У requires genitive case. What is the masculine genitive form of который?
Видел кого? — direct object of animate noun requires which case?
В + prepositional: what is the masculine prepositional form of который?
explanations: У governs genitive: у которого (masculine genitive of который).
Видеть requires accusative; animate masculine accusative = genitive form: которого.
В + prepositional case: в котором (masculine prepositional of который).
